note: WS-A contract pin (ov>0, strict): a float flush against a cell's RIGHT edge — touching the seam x=500 but not crossing it — has overlap AREA exactly 0 (ov_x = min(500,700)-max(0,500) = 0) and is filtered → null. A mere edge-touch is NOT 'sitting over' the cell; the caller falls back to sync-adopt rather than splitting a cell the float only abuts. Pins the `ov > 0` (strict, not >=) boundary so a future `ov >= 0` slip — which would make EVERY non-overlapping-but-aligned cell a candidate — reddens here.
